sections.heading: Nicki Minaj — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nicki Minaj was born on 8 December 1982 in Saint James, and holds citizenship of Trinidad and Tobago. She was given the name Onika Tanya Maraj at birth and is publicly known as Nicki Minaj.
She is a sibling of Ming Maraj.
She studied at Monroe University and Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School.
She is recorded as speaking English.
